skills.name: saleseq-docs
skills.description: Answer questions about how the SalesEQ product works — recording and the desktop app, sharing and permissions, groups, auto-share rules, public links, insights and reporting, calendar/email/HubSpot integrations, members and roles, billing, two-factor, and connecting SalesEQ to an AI assistant. Fetches the official docs rather than answering from memory. Use when someone asks how to do something in SalesEQ, why SalesEQ behaved a certain way, what a SalesEQ term means, or how a SalesEQ feature is configured. Do NOT use this to look up meeting content — the SalesEQ MCP tools handle searching meetings, reading transcripts, and pulling summaries.
headings: Fetch the docs; do not answer from memory
skills.description_zh: 查询 SalesEQ 官方文档解释产品使用和配置，包括录音、桌面应用、分享权限、群组、自动分享、公开链接、洞察报告、集成、成员角色、计费、双因素与 AI 助手连接；会议内容检索使用 MCP 工具。
